svg.title: MediaHub Relational Schema
svg.desc: Normalized relational schema for every MediaHub database table, with primary and foreign keys.
svg.text: PK is underlined conceptually; FK references are shown using →. Composite keys and unique constraints are explicitly listed.

g.text: Identity
ROLES(id PK, name UNIQUE NOT NULL)
USERS(id PK, role_id FK → ROLES.id, google_subject UNIQUE, email UNIQUE, display_name, status DEFAULT ACTIVE, ...)
USER_SESSIONS(sid PK, sess JSONB NOT NULL, expire NOT NULL)
AUDIT_LOGS(id PK, actor_user_id FK → USERS.id NULL, action, entity_type, entity_id, created_at DEFAULT now())
Catalogue
MEDIA_TYPES(id PK, code UNIQUE, name UNIQUE, section, progress_mode)
MEDIA_ITEMS(id PK, media_type_id FK → MEDIA_TYPES.id, created_by_user_id FK → USERS.id NULL,
title, normalized_title, cover_url NULL, total_units CHECK ≥ 0, origin, review_status, is_active DEFAULT true, ...)
GENRES(id PK, name UNIQUE, slug UNIQUE)
MEDIA_GENRES(media_item_id PK/FK → MEDIA_ITEMS.id, genre_id PK/FK → GENRES.id)
MEDIA_UNITS(id PK, media_item_id FK → MEDIA_ITEMS.id, parent_unit_id FK → MEDIA_UNITS.id NULL,
unit_kind, sequence_number CHECK ≥ 0, UNIQUE(media_item_id, unit_kind, sequence_number), ...)
Personal tracking
LIBRARY_ENTRIES(id PK, user_id FK → USERS.id, media_item_id FK → MEDIA_ITEMS.id,
current_unit_id FK → MEDIA_UNITS.id NULL, status DEFAULT PLANNED, progress_value DEFAULT 0 CHECK ≥ 0,
rating NULL CHECK 1..10, UNIQUE(user_id, media_item_id), ...)
PROGRESS_EVENTS(id PK, library_entry_id FK → LIBRARY_ENTRIES.id, unit_id FK → MEDIA_UNITS.id NULL,
old_progress NULL CHECK ≥ 0, new_progress CHECK ≥ 0, recorded_at DEFAULT now(), ...)
External metadata and controlled import
SOURCES(id PK, key UNIQUE, name UNIQUE, connector_kind, base_url, is_enabled DEFAULT true, terms_checked_at)
EXTERNAL_MAPPINGS(id PK, media_item_id FK → MEDIA_ITEMS.id, source_id FK → SOURCES.id, external_id,
source_url, UNIQUE(source_id, external_id), last_synced_at DEFAULT now())
INGESTION_JOBS(id PK, requested_by_user_id FK → USERS.id, source_id FK → SOURCES.id NULL, kind,
status DEFAULT QUEUED, candidate_count/imported_count/skipped_count/failed_count DEFAULT 0 CHECK ≥ 0, ...)
INGESTION_CANDIDATES(id PK, job_id FK → INGESTION_JOBS.id, source_id FK → SOURCES.id,
media_type_id FK → MEDIA_TYPES.id, match_media_id FK → MEDIA_ITEMS.id NULL, external_id,
normalized_payload JSONB, match_confidence NULL CHECK 0..1, UNIQUE(job_id, source_id, external_id), ...)
Recommendations
RECOMMENDATIONS(id PK, user_id FK → USERS.id, media_item_id FK → MEDIA_ITEMS.id,
score CHECK 0..1, model_version, reason, feedback DEFAULT NONE, generated_at DEFAULT now(),
UNIQUE(user_id, media_item_id, model_version, generated_at))
Index plan implemented
• Media search: MEDIA_ITEMS(media_type_id, normalized_title) and MEDIA_ITEMS(review_status, is_active, created_at DESC)
• Library dashboard: LIBRARY_ENTRIES(user_id, status, updated_at DESC) and LIBRARY_ENTRIES(user_id, updated_at DESC)
• Progress/history: PROGRESS_EVENTS(library_entry_id, recorded_at DESC); recommendations: RECOMMENDATIONS(user_id, score DESC)
• Import and source lookup: EXTERNAL_MAPPINGS(source_id, external_id), INGESTION_JOBS(requested_by_user_id, status, requested_at DESC),
INGESTION_CANDIDATES(job_id, decision), plus FK-supporting and unique indexes shown above.
